senses.gloss: विरूपय virūpa-ya, den. P. disfigure: pp. ita, 🞄disfigured.
वीरण vīraṇa, n. a fragrant grass (Andropogon 🞄muricatus).
वीरय vīrá-ya, den. Ā. act like a hero, display 🞄heroism (V.).
वीराय vīrā-ya, den. play the hero: pp. i-ta, 🞄n. imps..
वीरलोक vīra-loka, m. world of heroes, Indraʼs 🞄heaven: pl. brave men.
वीराणक vīrāṇa-ka, N. of a locality.

वीराशंसन vīra‿āśaṃsana, n. (indicative of 🞄heroes), battle-field;
 -āsana, n. kind of sitting 🞄posture with ascetics.
वीरिण vīriṇa, m. n. a grass with a fragrant 🞄root (Andropogon muricatus).

वीरेन्द्र vīra‿indra, m. chief of heroes;
 -īśa, 🞄m. a form of Śiva.
